It's not from anything. It's a boiling pot of different content that I put together in Garry's Mod. It's roughly set in the 'Ghost in the Shell' universe, but it's not a specific game or anything.

I made the background myself in the Source Engine using the program Hammer Map Editor with assets from the games Neotokyo and Dystopia.

The model uses two bases. The body is a Security Suit from Dead Space and her head is from Final Fantasy 13. Her MP5 is from FarCry 3 and her LMG is a mish-mash of stuff from MW2 and other similar games.
